lead: A scripted walkthrough of every Solvro screen on the finished UI pass: signed in as the admin demo user, on the demo workspace (4 customers, 6 projects, 59 tasks), at 1440×900 in dark and light themes and at 390×844 on a phone. Every step was screenshotted and checked for console errors, failed API calls and horizontal overflow, then looked at by eye.
verdict_title: Ready for your review and commit approval
verdict: All 38 walkthrough steps pass with no console errors, no failed API calls and no horizontal overflow. The first walkthrough found six visual defects; all six are fixed and confirmed in the final walkthrough below. The full end-to-end suite passes except the four PWA tests, which fail on the dev server by design.

stats.label: e2e tests pass (4 PWA fail by design)
defects found in QA, all fixed

fixed.title: Project header facts overlapped with the task panel open
fixed.what: With the side panel open, “7 of 17” ran into the Health fact. The facts row now wraps whole facts onto a second line instead of squeezing them.

fixed.title: Command palette list ran past its box
fixed.what: With Pages and Actions both listed, the last action drew below the palette's border. The list now scrolls inside the palette.

fixed.title: Daily Review still showed raw values and mixed type
fixed.what: Weekly health read “RED”, the baseline chip was in capitals, risk chips used raw colours and monospace, and counters read “0 / 3”. It now shows Red, No baseline, theme-aware risk chips and “0 of 3”.

fixed.title: Collapsed-sidebar tooltip was clipped
fixed.what: The tooltip sat against the rail and its first letter was cut off. It now opens clear of the rail with even padding.

fixed.title: Task form kept old placeholders and colours
fixed.what: Empty fields read “—” and “— Top level —”, and Medium priority was orange. They now read Pick start and due, Top level, No section, Critical path, with neutral Medium.

fixed.title: Two page headings after the sidebar started expanded
fixed.what: The sidebar's Solvro wordmark was a second page heading on every screen. It is now plain text, so each page has one heading.

checks.name: Quality gates (typechecks, unit tests in two time zones, smoke, guardrails, spine review)
checks.note: Backend and frontend typecheck, backend tests on the isolated test database, frontend tests in UTC and Asia/Jakarta, Playwright smoke, CHANGELOG and guardrail checks

checks.name: End-to-end suite, desktop and phone
checks.note: 4 PWA tests fail on the dev server by design; 6 drag-and-drop or iTop tests passed on retry (logged in docs/ISSUES.md)

checks.name: Code review
checks.note: Phase reviews found 2 blockers and 10 should-fix items; all were fixed before this walkthrough

checks.name: Walkthrough console and network
checks.note: No console errors, no 4xx/5xx API responses across 38 steps

known.title: Kanban card indent on desktop.
known.detail: The drag grip is hidden until hover on mouse devices but still reserves its space, so card titles start with a small gap on the left.

known.title: Drag-and-drop tests can be flaky.
known.detail: Four drag tests passed on retry; the sidebar now starts expanded at 1440 px, which narrows the board and is a suspect. Recorded in docs/ISSUES.md.

known.title: Tasks list stops at 200 rows.
known.detail: The page says “Showing 200 of N” when more match; paging is deferred.

known.title: Drawer focus handling.
known.detail: Dialogs now trap and return focus; the side drawer does not, because it is deliberately non-modal. Needs a decision.

known.title: iTop screens not exercised.
known.detail: iTop is not connected on the dev stack, so the Tickets tab and Utilization data states are covered only by their e2e tests.

footer: Walkthrough: scripted Playwright run against the dev stack (Vite on :5173), demo data reloaded before the run. Screenshots open full size in a new tab.
